name: Rhode Island
overview: Rhode Island has a refundable senior and disability circuit breaker for both homeowners and renters.

programs.name: Property Tax Relief Claim (RI-1040H)
programs.ageRule: Claimant or spouse age 65 or older, or receiving Social Security Disability benefits.
programs.incomeDefinition: Taxable and nontaxable income of all household members, with specified adjustments and loss addbacks.
programs.formulaSummary: Property taxes or 20% of qualifying rent, less an income-based threshold of 3%–6%; threshold depends on household income and size.
programs.application: File RI-1040H by April 15, 2026, with RI-1040 or separately. An income-tax filing extension does not extend this deadline.
eligibilityNotes: Current on rent and property taxes.
Exclude rent or taxes funded by public assistance and utility or furnishing charges.
interactions: Only one household member claims; rented land can be combined with taxes on an owned home.
programs.programYear: 2025 property taxes or rent and household income; Form RI-1040H claim due April 15, 2026.
